creator_and_cognitive_frameworks.loewenstein_information_gap: Curiosity requires a minimal knowledge anchor + an explicit missing outcome; show stakes in 0-2s and withhold resolution until final 15-20%.
creator_and_cognitive_frameworks.heath_made_to_stick_success: Simple (1 conflict), Unexpected (schema break in 0-3s), Concrete (visual stakes), Credible (genuine reaction), Emotional (high arousal -> shares), Stories (30s micro-arc).
creator_and_cognitive_frameworks.kahneman_cognitive_ease: Scroll feed runs on System 1; enforce 5th-grade captions, <=3 words/hit, APCA >=75, <=3 visual anchors so System 2 friction never triggers swipe-away.
creator_and_cognitive_frameworks.hillier_smith_retention_editing: Pacing is emotional contrast (tension & release), not robotic 1.5s cuts; every cut/zoom/overlay must be motivated and never smother authentic streamer emotion.
creator_and_cognitive_frameworks.paddy_galloway_ccn: Satisfy Core (lore), Casual (1-2s context), and New (zero-context visual hook); <=3 cover elements + complementary title/cover curiosity gap.
creator_and_cognitive_frameworks.jenny_hoyos_shorts: Frame-1 shock -> <3s clear stakes -> cut cleanly on climax resolution (avoid 20-25% final-second cliff).
creator_and_cognitive_frameworks.kallaway_triple_hook: Align Visual Hook (mute-readable) + Audio Hook (context lean) + Text Hook (pattern interrupt).
creator_and_cognitive_frameworks.derral_eves_youtube_formula: Algorithm follows audience behavior (CTR x Retention); diagnose drop-off timestamps systematically.
